lines.1: 「Now, Yashi will open the ballots and read them aloud.」
lines.3: 「Because you're the youngest, obviously! You first-year brat!」
lines.6: 「A is Konoe, and B is the Princess.」
lines.11: Sato began adding five-stroke tally marks beneath each name on the whiteboard.
lines.12: 「B, Princess... The next one is B, Princess.」
lines.15: 「That's nothing... I'll catch up from here.」
lines.21: 「B, B... B. ...The next one's B. Another B.」
lines.22: 「Ngh...! I can't believe B came up that many times in a row.」
lines.25: The voting was clearly starting to lean one way.
lines.28: 「Next is B, B, A, B, B...」
lines.31: 「Heh... Well, that's about what I expected.」
